self_label: FinTFM with a trained linear readout
bar_text: RandomForest (default), at 1,000 Elo, is the bar for resubmitting to TabArena (design review DR7.6, owner decision 2026-11-13). The reproduced entry is 19.6 Elo above it, inside the Elo interval of about ±75 (FINDINGS §303).
entry_text: It is not the zero-shot model. A linear model (logistic regression for classification, ridge or random-Fourier-feature ridge for regression) is fitted on the network's representation of each training split, one per partition leaf, and also takes the row's own features. Size-gated levers: four readout bags and spline features for small binary tables, one-hot indicators and spline features for multiclass, a random-Fourier-feature readout for small regression tables and spline features for all regression tables, with regression predictions clipped to the training target's range widened by 10% (FINDINGS §283, §286, §290, §293, §301). The board is the reproduction from the pull-request branch (fork 1aa50af) with no environment overrides, on Kaggle CPU, Kaggle and Hugging Face T4 GPUs and a Mac CPU; the stored runs it reproduces score 1,024.0 (FINDINGS §297, §301, §303). The binary, multiclass and regression checkpoints are all public under Apache-2.0 (fintfm 0.12.0). These are general-tabular results, not credit results: on real credit panels FinTFM currently loses to gradient boosting (FINDINGS §216).
types_note: Each figure comes from a leaderboard over that problem type's datasets only, so the four are not on one scale with each other or with the headline.
